Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The PR and Communications team manages Payward & Kraken’s reputation and oversees all aspects of the external communications strategy and execution globally. THE OPPORTUNITY Manager, Pro Trading & Derivatives Communications - The Manager of Pro Trading, Institutional & Derivatives Communications will inspire and support the team responsible for building and executing communications programs in support of Payward’s product strategy and Kraken's products and services targeted at professional traders, derivatives users and institutions globally. - Develop and execute an integrated external communications strategy aligned to Kraken's key business goals aimed at advancing the company's brand with key stakeholders across the pro trading, derivatives and institutional segments. - Develop strategies that expand Kraken's thought leadership positioning across professional and institutional client segments and work with the team in executing and expanding reach to new audiences through unique approaches to storytelling around trading products, risk management, and market infrastructure. - Develop and expand Kraken's bench of spokespeople in pro trading and derivatives, including building out key strategic messaging at the executive, product and segment level that resonates with traders, fund managers and institutional decision-makers. - Prepare communications materials including company announcements, talking points, media statements, speaker submissions, pitches and briefing materials tailored to professional and institutional audiences. - Build connectivity with multiple stakeholders including institutional partners, trading desks, market data providers, the communications team and key external agencies serving the pro/institutional space. - Bring social media first thinking to media relations and content, with particular attention to platforms and channels where professional traders and institutions gather. - Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. WHAT YOU BRING - Bachelor’s degree required along with 7+ years of proven experience leading and executing communications programs and initiatives, crypto experience preferred. - Highly proactive, determined and results driven. - Outstanding writing, editing and communications strategy skills. A hands on contributor with an ability to translate complex topics and capture the views and voices of senior leaders. - Experience working with a geographically dispersed workforce and managing complex communications challenges. - Experience working directly with executives to enhance executive presence, deliver strong messaging and improve presentation/interview skills. - A team player with a track record of success delivering high quality work in a fast paced, dynamic environment. - Experience leading, mentoring and scaling communications teams - Knowledgeable and passionate about the crypto industry Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Binance Accelerator Program - VIP Institutional Growth & Operations
items.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE. Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws About the Role We're looking for someone to join our VIP Institutional Growth & Operations team, supporting the growth, activation, and day-to-day operations of our institutional and VIP client products. You'll drive client growth initiatives while keeping the operational engine running cleanly. It's a high-exposure role for someone early in their career who wants to learn how an institutional product grows and operates end to end. What You'll Do - Growth and Operations Support Help identify and research high-potential institutional, broker, and VIP prospects. Support growth initiatives, prospect lists, account expansion plans, reactivation of dormant high-value accounts. Assist POCs and the growth team in preparing client proposals, incentive structures, and follow-ups. Coordinate operational workflows between growth, middle office, and support functions to remove onboarding and activation friction. - Data & Reporting Produce recurring reports (daily/weekly) on client volume, concentration, activation, and program performance. Pull and sanity-check data from internal data warehouses / BI tools and flag anomalies early. Support ad-hoc analysis for the growth and product teams. - Cross-Functional Coordination Partner with Product, Compliance, and Legal on client eligibility and incentive setup where required. Help maintain product documentation, process playbooks, and internal knowledge bases. Identify repetitive manual steps and suggest improvements or automation. What We're Looking For 0–2 years of experience (internships count) in operations, business/commercial analytics, product ops, growth, or a related function. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with numbers, thresholds, and structured criteria. Working proficiency with spreadsheets; basic SQL or a clear willingness to learn quickly. Clear written communication, able to summarize data and decisions crisply for stakeholders. Highly organized; able to juggle recurring deadlines and batch processes without dropping details. Based in the UAE or able to work effectively on a UAE-aligned schedule (remote). Nice-to-have Familiarity with crypto / exchange / fintech products and VIP or institutional client programs. Understanding of trading mechanics (spot/futures, maker/taker, fee tiers, rebates). Exposure to BI tools and data warehouses. Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. items.title: Director, Operations - Fanatics Events
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About Fanatics Events Fanatics is a global leader in licensed sports merchandise, collectibles, and fan experiences. Our newest platform, Fanatics Events, creates large-scale consumer festivals and live experiences that bring fans, athletes, and partners together. Our flagship productions include: Fanatics Fest – A first-of-its-kind multi-day fan festival hosted at the world-class Javits Center, combining sports, collectibles, athlete appearances, and immersive activations. WWE World – A multi-day consumer event produced in partnership with WWE, bringing fans closer to superstars, storylines, and experiences during major tentpole weekends. The Role The Operations Director owns the technical and back of house engine behind Fanatics Fest, WWE World, and other flagship Fanatics Events productions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Operations, this leader manages day-to-day AV operations, stage and Fanatics Games execution, and the back of house perimeter, while partnering closely with the Live Content, Exhibitor Customer Success, and Fulfillment teams to keep every stage and every exhibitor set up for success. The ideal candidate is highly detail oriented, thrives in a fast-paced live event environment, and is comfortable being the go-to problem solver onsite when a curveball comes their way. This role requires travel and onsite presence for load-in, show days, and load-out, including nights and weekends as needed. What You'll Do AV & Stage Operations Own the day-to-day audio visual operations across all stages and activations, including equipment inventory, vendor coordination, and real-time troubleshooting. Manage the daily operations of all event stages and the Fanatics Games footprint, ensuring schedules, staging, and technical requirements are executed on time and to spec. Live Content Support Partner with and support the Live Content team across every stage, coordinating run-of-show logistics, technical rehearsals, talent load-in/load-out, and show-calling support. Back of House (BOH) Perimeter Management Own the planning and day-to-day management of the back of house perimeter, including fencing and barricade layout, vendor load-in routes, and coordination with security. Manage barricade and bike rack vendors, ensuring correct placement, delivery, and breakdown across the event footprint. items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com The Role - Staff Product Manager, Digital Match Capture The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Staff Product Manager to lead our digital match capture products. As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with leading global sporting leagues (e.g., NBA, EPL, NFL, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver tracking data to teams, leagues, and external developers around the world. You will own positional tracking for both first-party and third-party use-cases across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement. You will identify opportunities to lead the market, improve positional tracking, and determine the best ways to use match capture to deliver value to the Genius Sports product portfolio and its customers. Positional tracking forms the bedrock of Genius tracking-derived products, including performance, officiating, automated data collection, media visualizations, and emerging digital recreation use-cases. You will also help shape what comes next in match capture. The lines between positional tracking, computer vision, digital twins, and 3D capture are blurring quickly, and you will explore where they meet: running prototypes and early deployments with our engineers and partners, learning what works, and bringing the most promising ideas into the core match capture platform. The ideal candidate is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a product used both as a customer-facing offering and as a platform for the broader Genius portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data. What You Will Own: As the Staff Product Manager, Digital Match Capture, you will be responsible for digital match capture spanning first-party and third-party use-cases: First-Party Positional Tracking — Tracking products that power the Genius Sports portfolio, including performance, officiating, automated data collection, media visualizations, and digital recreation inputs. Third-Party Positional Tracking — Tracking products and capabilities delivered to teams, leagues, and external developers. Positional Tracking Improvement & Market Leadership — A roadmap of continual improvements to tracking quality, coverage, and capability, including opportunities to lead the market. Next-Generation Match Capture Exploration — Discovery and validation of emerging capture capabilities that blend positional tracking, computer vision, digital twins, 3D capture, and real-time systems. Portfolio Value — Identifying and delivering the highest-value ways for digital match capture to serve Genius Sports products and customers. Job Responsibilities: Build, Maintain, and Grow Genius Digital Match Capture Operate as a platform product manager: balance first-party and third-party requirements, treat application product managers as customers, and define well-defined interfaces that enable both without fragmenting the platform. Understand customer needs across teams, leagues, external developers, and internal application teams; develop requirements and drive delivery of positional tracking for both first-party and third-party use-cases. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post- launch growth and iteration — including both live-operations quality and reliability and net-new capability. Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for digital match capture, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate closely with computer vision, systems, and data platform engineers, downstream product managers, match and venue operations, design, and business teams to ensure digital match capture initiatives are delivered on time and on budget. Explore next-generation capture opportunities that could improve tracking quality, coverage, automation, or downstream recreation use-cases, using evidence from prototypes, early deployments, and customer feedback to decide what to scale and what to stop. Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for digital match capture, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners. Balance investment across digital match capture across three horizons — Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months) — ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation. Define KPIs that drive business results for digital match capture, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis. Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to support go-to market motions with product expertise, and continuously gather feedback from teams, leagues, external developers, and application product managers and translate it into product requirements. Mentor less experienced product managers and raise the quality of product practice around you. Stay current on computer vision tracking technology, real-time data platforms, next-generation capture techniques, and competitor offerings to keep Genius digital match capture at the forefront of the industry. Position Requirements: 6-12 years of relevant product management experience. Experience leading a complex product or platform with significant business, customer, or operational impact — shaping strategy, driving discovery, and aligning stakeholders across teams. Product management experience building B2B SaaS, platform, or data products: understanding functional requirements and building for scale, including balancing first-party and third-party (or multiple-customer) needs through well-defined interfaces. Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes. Experience leading complex cross-functional programs with engineering, operations, and downstream product partners; able to influence without authority and treat application teams as customers. Technical fluency sufficient to work with computer vision, systems, and data platform engineers on real-time products; comfort moving between deep technical conversations and product/commercial tradeoffs. Ability to create clarity in technically ambiguous spaces, especially where positional tracking, 3D capture, digital twins, and real-time systems begin to overlap. Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience aligning stakeholders, presenting to leadership, and supporting commercial conversations with product expertise. Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs). Proficiency in gathering and transforming product requirements into a practical, prioritized product roadmap. Track record of mentoring less experienced product managers, or otherwise raising the quality of product practice around you. Domain experience in sports, computer vision, real-time systems, developer/platform products, 3D capture, or digital twins is a plus; familiarity with WebGPU, Unity, Unreal, or comparable engines/runtimes is a plus. Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. What Success Looks Like: Digital match capture is a uniform, market-leading product across basketball, soccer, and American football. Tracking is a core platform feature that can be used by any first-party or third party developer as a core data service. Product decisions are consistently grounded in customer needs and data to drive our Genius revenue streams, with clear KPIs tracked and acted on. Next-generation capture ideas are tested with real evidence from prototypes and early deployments, and the best of them make the tracking platform stronger. Cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data ops, commercial) trust the roadmap and rely on the PM as the source of truth for digital match capture product direction. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. This is not a support function. You will be the named security officer for your entities, accountable to their boards and their regulators. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a member of the International Policy Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to governments, AI Safety Institutes (AISIs), and multilateral institutions. You'll use your technical skills and your experience with government partners to help them understand frontier AI, test it, and apply it to their public missions with a high degree of reliability and safety. This role serves Anthropic's policy, mission, and public benefit goals. In collaboration with the Policy, Product, Research, and Engineering teams, you'll help partners develop strategies and plans to evaluate and adopt leading-edge AI systems. You will use your excellent communication skills to explain complex topics, including the potential benefits and harms of frontier AI, to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You will also play a critical role in identifying how our AI systems can best serve public interests around the world, while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards. Responsibilities: Act as a primary technical advisor for senior officials in partner governments, AISIs, and international institutions. Brief them on frontier AI capabilities, give an honest account of both benefits and harms, and explain safety research in terms that inform their decisions. Partner closely with the Policy team to understand each partner's goals and requirements. Develop demos, pilots, prototypes, and evaluation suites that show how Claude can support their public missions, such as cyber defense. Lead technical onboarding, enablement, and hands-on workshops for partner institutions, including national cybersecurity agencies. Guide their setup, architecture, and integration as they build with Claude Code and the Claude API. Act as the voice of our international partners and a key collaborator with our Product and Research teams to ensure we deliver the capabilities they need. Travel internationally to partner institutions for senior leader meetings, technical enablement, and building relationships. Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI. Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models’ capabilities. You may be a good fit if you have: 4+ years of experience as a Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Cybersecurity Engineer, working with governments, international organizations, or the public sector Experience in technology policy, AI safety, cybersecurity, or international affairs Designed novel and innovative solutions for technical platforms in a developing mission area Familiarity with how AI models are evaluated and tested for safety Strong technical aptitude to partner with engineers and strong proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) Understanding of and experience with LLM fundamentals The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders, from engineers to senior government officials Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 — $315,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. On the maintenance side, you drive the network repair program including: break-fix and ticket flow, vendor RMA, sparing policies, and the SLAs which operations partners execute against. Finally, some of this work touches core networks, where you will partner with Anthropics WAN/Core network team to support campus/DC core network deployment and maintenance activities. This is a program and execution role. You will work with the Global Capacity Delivery Program Leads, the Repairs Program Leads, and the broader Data Center Operations organization to extend network coverage across more sites and platforms as the fleet grows. Expect 50%+ travel: you get eyes on the floor at each site during network delivery, turn-up, QA, and close-out, and at sites where repair performance needs attention. Your authority comes from being on site where you foster strong relationships with on site teams. Working with third party vendors and partners, you set direction, priorities, and standards for execution. Success is defined against Anthropic-owned ticket and telemetry data you’ve built rather than self-reported status. If you have deployed and maintained data center networks at scale, are passionate about hyperscale data centers, & enjoy working in complex, fast-paced environments, we welcome you to apply. Responsibilities Include: Own network deployment outcomes for your assigned sites and data-hall waves: DCN, management, telemetry, Accelerator chip back-end networks, aggregation layer(s) turned up and accepted on schedule, with exceptions closed out, or risk called early enough for leadership to act. Engage from construction kickoff and confirm network readiness ahead of each wave: pathways and fiber trays, cabling and optics on hand, receiving paths, and partner staffing, working the gaps with the site operations partner and facilities counterparts before gear arrives. Be on site at key points during network delivery, cabling, turn-up, QA, and close-out; verify the work with your own eyes rather than from a dashboard, and support the on-site teams with your direct expertise. Validate the handover gate for each network build: cabling and link validation complete, acceptance criteria met, documentation delivered, spares positioned, ticketing live, and a structured handover into production operations and the repair program. Manage RMA and spares for network gear with vendors and site operations partners, including warranty claims, return cycle times, and spares levels by site and part, so that parts availability never gates a repair SLA. Lead the operating cadence with partner site leads, including weekly deployment and repair reviews and scorecards; analyze failure patterns and drive corrective actions with network engineering, suppliers, and the WAN/Core teams when the core network/MMR is involved. Turn lessons from each deployment and repair into program standards (procedures, checklists, acceptance criteria, and metrics), and communicate status, dependencies, and risk to engineering, capacity planning, and leadership. Can demonstrate a proven track record leading data center network deployments at a large scale across multiple sites or data-hall waves, from early floor access through turn-up and acceptance. Have run break-fix or repair programs for network hardware, including ticket flow, RMA, and spares, and managed vendors, OEMs, or contract workforces to measurable outcomes: milestones, SLAs, quality gates, operational reviews, and corrective action. Possess hands-on technical depth in data center networking, including switches, structured cabling, fiber, and optics, enough to independently verify turn-up and repair quality and audit vendor claims. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools. This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0. - Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves. - Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready. - Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering. - Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples. - Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic. - Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is looking for a Customer Marketing Manager to make sure our most important messages are backed by customers who can speak to them. This role works across regions and customer segments on special projects tied to the company's top priorities. When we launch a new model, feature, or initiative, you'll find the customers who can speak to it and get them on the record. We're looking for an excellent communicator who can turn customer stories into multiple formats that flex across channels. This often means working under compressed timelines and leading customer storytelling on some of the most important projects at Anthropic. You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Brand, Comms, Customer Marketing segment leads, and the writers on our team. The right person has done both product marketing and customer marketing, and has a reporter's nose for a good story. Key responsibilities Own the customer evidence strategy for the company's top priorities, deciding which claims need customer proof, which customers are best placed to back them up, and where we have gaps to close Bring what customers are telling us back to Product Marketing and Sales, so our messaging reflects what lands with buyers Stand up new programs as company priorities shift, setting the scope, the customer list, and the plan to ship quickly Lead the customer plan for major model and product launches, from which customers we engage with to how their voices show up in the announcement Partner with Brand and Creative on which customer stories anchor our campaigns and how we tell them Build proof point libraries and enablement around our key messages, so account teams know which story to use and when Shape the customer narrative our executives use in keynotes, posts, and customer conversations Prioritize customer asks when several teams want to tap the same customer, and work with Comms, Legal, and customer executives to get high-profile stories approved Minimum qualifications Can read a messaging doc and quickly spot what customer proof it needs and where the gaps are Are a strong writer and interviewer who can get a customer to say something specific and true, then turn it into a story people want to read Have supported product launches and campaigns with customer proof, often on tight timelines Have built sales enablement that sales teams kept using after launch week Are comfortable with technical products and can explain/write what a customer built, and why it matters, in plain language Know how to work across a lot of teams without formal authority, and can say “not yet” when a request doesn't fit the plan Have good judgment about when a story is ready and when it needs more work Enjoy moving between very different projects, sometimes in the same week Already use Claude to help with drafts and interview prep Preferred qualifications Have 7+ years in B2B marketing, with time in both product marketing and customer marketing Worked in AI or developer tools A background in journalism or editorial A background in Product Marketing or Messaging Written keynotes or LinkedIn posts for executives Run message testing or win/loss interviews to learn what buyers respond to Worked with Comms or analyst relations on announcements that featured customers The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
